_meta.purpose: Seed catalog for the gateway-membership recommender (memberships.json in the app). Each entry = a museum that SELLS a reciprocal-granting membership, its cheapest qualifying tier, and which of the app's 7 networks that tier unlocks.
_meta.prices_note: Prices are approximate and were gathered 2026-09 from museum pages and prior project research. ALWAYS reconfirm on the museum's own membership page before relying on them; museums change tiers/prices. lat/lng are approximate city-level and should be replaced by real geocoding.

gateways.name: Kern County Museum
gateways.notes: The most networks with a digital card: it comes via Join It (Apple/Google Wallet), though the card face shows only the Kern seal (no reciprocal logos). Some directories also list ROAM — verify.

gateways.name: Boonshoft Museum of Discovery (Dayton Society of Natural History)
gateways.notes: The only strong AZA (zoos/aquariums) gateway that also has a digital card. ASTC+AZA at Standard/Premium; ACM added at Family level. Family price seen as $135–$155 — verify.

gateways.name: Cincinnati Museum Center
gateways.notes: ASTC + Time Travelers at ALL levels; ACM added at Family/Family Premium. Family ~$120–$150 — verify. Digital card via Member Portal. Good Time-Travelers gateway with a digital card.

gateways.name: Western Science Center
gateways.notes: Cheapest single-network (ASTC-only) option (~$45 individual) — good if you just want ASTC at the lowest price. Price and digital-card status — verify.

gateways.name: Dennos Museum Center
gateways.notes: ~$100 family for ASTC + NARM + ROAM — three networks cheaply.

gateways.name: Peoria Riverfront Museum
gateways.notes: ASTC + NARM + Time Travelers with an Apple/Google Wallet card. Price — verify.

gateways.name: Newfields (Indianapolis Museum of Art)
gateways.notes: Adds AHS (gardens) — the hardest network to pick up. Also NARM + ROAM. Has a digital card. Also lists MARP (out of scope). Price/tier — verify.

gateways.name: New Jersey State Museum
gateways.notes: High coverage (4 in-scope networks + MARP), but reciprocity only at ~$250 Sponsor and PHYSICAL CARD ONLY (no digital). Included for completeness, not as a cheap gateway.

gateways.name: New Britain Museum of American Art (Hungerford)
gateways.notes: Highest coverage (6 of the networks here), but physical card only. Price/tier — verify.
